cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says lawyers or litigants can file with the courts online. The e-court's electronic filing is described as part of a pilot.
cells.note: The Judiciary's April 2024 concept note says digital case management platforms have already been introduced (MWI-002), so stage 3. Its e-court with electronic filing was a pilot in ten courts (MWI-001), which does not show lawyers filing online.
